description: This file defines Vietnamese (Vietnam) culture information for the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds minutes to the date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds hours to the date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds days to the date.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets date components based on configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves date to the nth occurrence of a weekday in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves date to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Returns the week number of the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the date to a specific week number.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the date within the month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is currently observing daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts date to ISO string format.
